name: Nuxt
description: Full-stack web framework built on Vue.
summary: Nuxt welcomes AI-assisted contributions, including AI-generated code, as long as you fully understand what you submit and can explain it. Comments, issues and pull request descriptions must be written in your own words, and automated agents may open PRs or issues only by adding 🤖🤖🤖 to the title.
